intent: Boolean toggle with an inline label for a single on/off choice.
useWhen: One independent boolean such as agree to terms or enable notifications
Inside Field only when you need hint or error below the control
doNotUseWhen: Choosing one of several options — use RadioGroup
Multiple checkboxes in a set — use several Checkbox components in a Fieldset-like layout via Field
Primary form submit actions — use Button

requirements: Label is clickable and tied to input via htmlFor/id

doNot: Do not use RadioGroup for booleans
snippet: <Checkbox id="terms" label="I agree to the terms" />
